resolved_prior_blocker.summary: Prior (v3-era) PARTIAL dispatch found the multi-diamond-witness case needs a bridge hypothesis beyond h_Kdia to convert '(diamond A) -> (box B)' into 'box (A -> B)' -- exactly Fischer-Servi Idb.
resolved_prior_blocker.resolution: Plan v4 (report 03) added h_Idb as a threaded parametric hypothesis. This dispatch confirmed h_Idb closes exactly this shape mismatch: after combining the diamond hypotheses used by a derivation into `bigAnd As` via h_andI/h_andE1/h_andE2 and bridging `dia(bigAnd As) -> bigAnd(dia-mapped As)` via h_Kdia (dia_bigAnd_to_bigAnd_dia), h_Idb converts `(dia(bigAnd As)).imp(box psi)` into `box((bigAnd As).imp psi)`, which `{psi|box psi in w.val} subseteq u.val` places directly in u.val.
